ours.name: flutter3d_audio_core
ours.description: Positional audio for flutter3d without a backend: attenuation, panning, occlusion, voice limiting and the mixer's buses.

ours.name: flutter3d_camera
ours.description: Virtual cameras for flutter3d games: priorities and blends between them (cut, ease, a curve of your own), framing by targets with dead zones and damping, group shots, keeping clear of walls, and impulse shake seeded by the step. A director, and a plugin that places it in the frame phase `camera`.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_kit
ours.description: Gameplay parts for flutter3d games, one library each: reactions, a soundtrack, ghosts of past runs, seeded levels, the world past the simulated square, ragdolls, burning wrecks and party sessions.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_platformer
ours.description: A second genre: a runner who jumps twice and dashes, things to collect, hazards to fall into, and checkpoints to come back at.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_racing
ours.description: A third genre: a car with grip it can lose, a track measured in metres, and the lap that comes of going round it.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_shooter
ours.description: The parts of a first-person shooter that are not parts of an engine: monsters, weapons, an inventory, and the step order that ties them together.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_strategy
ours.description: A fourth genre: ground made of samples, units that move as a crowd rather than one at a time, and orders given to a selection instead of to a body.

ours.name: flutter3d_game_ui
ours.description: The widgets around a flutter3d game, one library each: the HUD, touch controls, accessibility, title and credits screens, photo mode, and recording and sharing a run.

ours.name: flutter3d_plugin_runtime
ours.description: Plugins loaded while a game runs: data plugins read from a .f3dplugin document, sandboxed Wasm modules stepped by a deterministic interpreter, and the interface an interpreted script runs behind, each held to the permissions its manifest declares and the application grants.

ours.name: flutter3d_post
ours.description: Post-processing for flutter3d, one library per family: light, shading, reflections, atmosphere, motion and style, and the standard preset of all six. Each effect is a plugin and the switch of its own render step.
